scripts.build:hostinger: VITE_API_URL=${VITE_API_URL:-https://desk-noae.onrender.com} vite build && cd dist && rm -f ../ziondesk-hostinger.zip && zip -qr ../ziondesk-hostinger.zip . -x '*.DS_Store' && echo '→ ziondesk-hostinger.zip (upload its contents to public_html)'
scripts.build:admin: VITE_ADMIN_ONLY=1 VITE_API_URL=${VITE_API_URL:-https://desk-noae.onrender.com} vite build --outDir dist-admin --emptyOutDir && sed -i '' 's|<If "%{HTTP_HOST} =~ /^admin\\./">|<If "true">|' dist-admin/.htaccess && cd dist-admin && rm -f ../ziondesk-admin.zip && zip -qr ../ziondesk-admin.zip . -x '*.DS_Store' && echo '→ ziondesk-admin.zip (upload its contents to the admin domain folder)'
